questions.q: Why does Northbridge install kube-prometheus-stack twice instead of once?
options: Because Prometheus can only scrape one namespace per install
Because northbridge-aks-dev and northbridge-aks-prod are separate clusters, each needing its own monitoring stack
Because Helm charts cannot be reused across environments
questions.explain: northbridge-aks-dev (hosting dev and staging) and northbridge-aks-prod are physically separate AKS clusters, so each needs its own kube-prometheus-stack install.

questions.q: What does a ServiceMonitor resource do?
options: It restarts a pod when it becomes unhealthy
It tells Prometheus where and how often to scrape a service's /metrics endpoint
questions.explain: ServiceMonitor is the CRD that tells Prometheus which service to scrape, on which port and path, and at what interval.

questions.q: What do the three panels of a RED-method dashboard measure?
questions.explain: RED stands for Rate, Errors, and Duration — the three request-level signals tracked per service.

questions.q: What is the checkout service's defined SLO?
options: 99.5% of requests under 800ms p99, measured against a rolling 30-day error budget
questions.explain: Checkout's SLO is 99.5% of requests completing under 800ms p99, tracked against a rolling 30-day error budget.

questions.q: Where do alerts labeled severity: page end up, per the Alertmanager config?
options: A ticket in the backlog for next sprint
questions.explain: The Alertmanager route sends anything matching severity: page to the northbridge-on-call receiver, which posts to the #northbridge-on-call Slack channel.
